mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the model to produce a world where an unauthenticated Operation has outcome=Success, directly violating the authentication-boundary invariant in FR-001.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthBypass { some op: Operation | op.role = Unauth and op.outcome = Success }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a PATCH operation on a Done task with KeepsDone intent to succeed, violating the closed-task edit rule (FR-011 / 409 task_closed).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClosedTaskViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = PatchTask and op.targetTask.status = Done and op.patchIntent = KeepsDone and op.outcome = Success }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets the model produce two DeletionLog entries pointing to the same task, violating the append-only / no-duplicate invariant that protects the deletion audit trail.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateLogEntry { some disj d1, d2: DeletionLog | d1.loggedTask = d2.loggedTask }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a DeletionLog entry whose deletedBy member does not match any successful DeleteTask operation caller, breaking attribution correctness and audit completeness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedLog { some d: DeletionLog | all op: Operation | not (op.kind = DeleteTask and op.targetTask = d.loggedTask and op.caller = d.deletedBy and op.outcome = Success) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix fact lets the Allowed relation be arbitrary, which can produce a world where Unauth has a permitted operation or AuthMember is missing a permission — violating both LeastPrivilege and PermissionCompleteness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionMatrixViolation { Unauth -> PostTasks in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a successful DeleteTask operation with no corresponding DeletionLog entry, meaning deletions can go unlogged and violating FR-018's audit-log requirement.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnloggedDeletion { some op: Operation | op.kind = DeleteTask and op.outcome = Success and all d: DeletionLog | d.loggedTask != op.targetTask }
